next.reason: 1985 REWRITE GR3: the released record is no longer in the record area unless the file is in a SAME RECORD AREA clause, and is then also a record of the other files in that clause. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR6 restates it nearly verbatim ('is no longer available in the record area unless file-name-1 or the file-name associated with record-name-1 is specified in a SAME RECORD AREA clause'); §2023:12.4.6.4.4 GR2 states the sharing ('a logical record of each file open in the output mode'). file-name-1 serves only the new REWRITE FILE form.
